trans-unit.source: Healthcare services in the Czech Republic: mandatory health insurance, standard medical care, what to do in emergency situations.
trans-unit.target: Healthcare services in the Czech Republic: mandatory health insurance, standard medical care, what to do in emergency situations.

trans-unit.source: Healthcare services in the Czech Republic are provided to all residents based on universal health insurance.
trans-unit.target: Healthcare services in the Czech Republic are provided to all residents based on universal health insurance.

source.g: Having valid and paid health insurance is mandatory for everyone in the Czech Republic.

target.g: Having valid and paid health insurance is mandatory for everyone in the Czech Republic.

trans-unit.source: All Czech citizens and EU residents are participants in public health insurance, along with:
trans-unit.target: All Czech citizens and EU residents are participants in public health insurance, along with:

trans-unit.source: foreigners under 18 with valid long-term residence permits
trans-unit.target: foreigners under 18 with valid long-term residence permits

trans-unit.source: all other foreigners who are employed
trans-unit.target: all other foreigners who are employed

trans-unit.source: Foreigners with other types of residency who are not employed must have commercial health insurance with a private insurance company.
trans-unit.target: Foreigners with other types of residency who are not employed must have commercial health insurance with a private insurance company.

trans-unit.source: If you have public health insurance, you must ensure that the premium is paid every month, whether by your employer or by yourself. If you belong to one of the categories of persons for whom the state pays the insurance premium, you must report this to the insurance company.
trans-unit.target: If you have public health insurance, you must ensure that the premium is paid every month, whether by your employer or by yourself. If you belong to one of the categories of persons for whom the state pays the insurance premium, you must report this to the insurance company.

trans-unit.source: Always carry your health insurance card with you!
trans-unit.target: Always carry your health insurance card with you!

trans-unit.source: Everyone should be registered with a general practitioner. You can contact them with any health issues, and they will refer you to a specialist (neurologist, urologist, etc.) if necessary. Children must also have a general practitioner.
trans-unit.target: Everyone should be registered with a general practitioner. You can contact them with any health issues, and they will refer you to a specialist (neurologist, urologist, etc.) if necessary. Children must also have a general practitioner.

trans-unit.source: In addition to a general practitioner, you should also have a dentist and, for women, a gynecologist.
trans-unit.target: In addition to a general practitioner, you should also have a dentist and, for women, a gynecologist.

trans-unit.source: If you cannot find a doctor or are refused by doctors, contact your health insurance company, which will provide you with a list of contracted doctors who can treat you. Because there is a shortage of doctors, it is possible that a doctor might refuse you due to capacity issues, in which case you will need to continue searching.
trans-unit.target: If you cannot find a doctor or are refused by doctors, contact your health insurance company, which will provide you with a list of contracted doctors who can treat you. Because there is a shortage of doctors, it is possible that a doctor might refuse you due to capacity issues, in which case you will need to continue searching.

trans-unit.source: It’s a phone line that brings emergency responders to the patient. It should only be used in cases of sudden serious illness or injury when the patient cannot get to a doctor by themselves, and when quick on-site treatment and possible transport to a medical facility is necessary to prevent further health deterioration or life-threatening conditions.
trans-unit.target: It’s a phone line that brings emergency responders to the patient. It should only be used in cases of sudden serious illness or injury when the patient cannot get to a doctor by themselves, and when quick on-site treatment and possible transport to a medical facility is necessary to prevent further health deterioration or life-threatening conditions.

trans-unit.source: You can use the 112 emergency number even if you don’t speak Czech, as operators speak multiple languages. However, it’s important to know that the call will initially be answered by a firefighter, which may cause some delay when transferring the call.
trans-unit.target: You can use the 112 emergency number even if you don’t speak Czech, as operators speak multiple languages. However, it’s important to know that the call will initially be answered by a firefighter, which may cause some delay when transferring the call.

trans-unit.source: ZÁCHRANKA – mobile app for emergency calls
trans-unit.target: ZÁCHRANKA – mobile app for emergency calls

trans-unit.source: We recommend installing the Záchranka app on your mobile phone for quick contact with emergency medical services. The app sends an emergency message with your exact location. You can use the app to call for help even if you are unable to speak.
trans-unit.target: We recommend installing the Záchranka app on your mobile phone for quick contact with emergency medical services. The app sends an emergency message with your exact location. You can use the app to call for help even if you are unable to speak.

trans-unit.source: If your situation does not require calling an ambulance, and it’s outside of your general practitioner’s working hours, you can visit any emergency room.
trans-unit.target: If your situation does not require calling an ambulance, and it’s outside of your general practitioner’s working hours, you can visit any emergency room.

trans-unit.source: Outside of these hours, emergency services are provided by the doctors at the Central admission for the internal clinics.
trans-unit.target: Outside of these hours, emergency services are provided by the doctors at the Central admission for the internal clinics.
